text:
sam_sales: heads-up - NovaPulse wants a short POC but insists EU-only processing for PHI, plus BYO-KMS in eu-west-1. they asked: any chance of requests leaking to non-EU during failover?
meera_presales: do they mean hard block (no cross-border under any condition) or 'prefer EU but allow emergency failover'?
sam_sales: hard block. legal will need attestation and subproc list.
diego_infra: hosted public has regional routing but automatic fallback exists if capacity depleted (usually to nearby region, could be non-EU). that would violate a hard block.
meera_presales: so Dedicated or Private is required to guarantee residency?
diego_infra: yes. Dedicated with region-pinned GPU pools or Private VPC keeps all request/response paths in the chosen region and disables cross-region failover.
anna_legal: NovaPulse will need our EU sub-processor inventory + signed attestation. @infra_bot can you confirm the current EU subproc snapshot?
infra_bot: /artifacts/subprocessors_eu_2026-02-14.csv — contains: cloud-hosting-eu, logs-managed-eu, metrics-eu. note: telemetry agents run globally but for Dedicated/Private PHI is not exported outside EU.
meera_presales: BYO-KMS in eu-west-1 supported for Private and for Dedicated via customer key provisioning. hosted public cannot guarantee key residency today.
sam_sales: pricing ask: small POC (baseline 500 qps, spikes to 2k). any ballpark for Dedicated?
diego_infra: rough estimate: €10k/month baseline + one-time setup €3.5k for network pinning and certs. add burst plan if they need short-term autoscale (but that can reintroduce residency risk if using hosted burst).
anna_legal: we'll need an SLA amendment for 'no-cross-border' clause and to update DPA/subproc annex. legal review ~5 business days after draft.
meera_presales: action items: 1) share subproc CSV + BYO-KMS caveat 2) prepare Dedicated quote + provisioning ETA 3) schedule technical sync with NovaPulse. can we have quote + one-pager by EOD tomorrow?
diego_infra: i'll reserve tentative provisioning window next week and open ticket INF-9002 to track routing enforcement options.
infra_bot: reminder: include BYO-KMS key rotation, revocation, and crypto escrow notes in handoff docs.
sam_sales: i'll email NovaPulse with the summary and book a sync. thanks team :thumbsup:
